name: isomorphic-dompurify
notes: Runs DOMPurify on jsdom for server-side use. Pulls 27.4 MB and 28 packages, so its exposure includes jsdom's own advisory stream. Single-maintainer wrapper.

build_vs_buy.effort: do not build; you are buying the engine and a DOM shim
build_vs_buy.rationale: You are buying DOMPurify's engine plus a DOM shim; building either is out of scope.
